messages.敵に「視線」を集めて「軽蔑」に変え、強化S3で一気に撃ち抜く出血・振動の人格。: A Bleed and Tremor Identity that gathers Gaze on enemies, converts it into Contempt, then fires enhanced S3 for a burst of damage.
messages.視線と軽蔑: 視線は最大7で、1につき良秀からの被・与ダメージ量+10%。ターン: **Gaze and Contempt**: Gaze has a maximum of 7, and each point gives +10% damage dealt to and taken from Ryōshū. At 7 at Turn End, it becomes Contempt next turn (−50% damage dealt to and taken from Ryōshū), and Contempt reverts to 7 Gaze the following turn. It is inflicted by S1–S3 and the combat passive @#$'s Hand I Let Slip (2 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ).
messages.出血と振動: 各スキルで出血と振動を付与し、合計に応じてコイン威力・ダメージ量が: **Bleed and Tremor**: Each skill inflicts Bleed and Tremor, and Coin Power and damage rise based on their total. S2 triggers Tremor Burst if the target has at least 3 Tremor Count, and S3 triggers Tremor Burst with Coin Ⅲ and converts into Tremor - Hemorrhage if it hits without being broken.
messages.「軽蔑の下に降り注ぐ畏敬の視線」: 全ての敵の視線の合計が7以上か軽蔑が1以上な: **Cascading Gaze of Awe Underneath Contempt**: S3 changes into this when the total Gaze across all enemies is 7 or more or Contempt is 1 or more. A 1-Coin big hit with +200% damage against a single target, and even more against targets with Contempt. It spends all Gaze and Contempt after the attack.
messages.視線の軽蔑: 守備の戦闘開始時、条件を満たすと得る。保護7・ダメージ量減少7を得: **Contempt of the Gaze**: Gained at Combat Start of her Defense skill when the condition is met. She gains 7 Protection and 7 Damage Down, and her Aggro increases by 20.
messages.S1・S2で視線・出血・振動を積み、視線の合計が7以上か軽蔑が付いたら強化S3で: Stack Gaze, Bleed, and Tremor with S1 and S2, and once total Gaze reaches 7 or Contempt is applied, blast through with the enhanced S3. Paired with Yi Sang's N Corp. E.G.O:: Fell Bullet, only on turns when Ryōshū has Contempt of the Gaze, Yi Sang's S3 Target Readjustment Fire turns into I Shall Fire / Anytime, which shoots Ryōshū, once per turn.
